reason: I've already got a Fresha booking page that's free and does the job, and Wix is about £15 a month if I want something nicer. £655 to a company in Kuwait with no reviews is a lot when nobody in my Facebook group has heard of them.
objection: Why pay £655 when I already have a booking page that people find me on? I don't see what a proper website gets me that Fresha doesn't, and I can't ask anyone local if they're any good.
would_change_my_mind: Someone in my local Facebook group recommending them, plus a price closer to £300.
